name: SDD Atomic Tasks Template (Explicit RED-GREEN-REFACTOR-SMOKE)
description: Atomic task-based SDD with 70 sequential tasks (TASK-001 to TASK-070) using explicit action verbs (EXECUTE, RUN, COMPILE, SHOW, CONFIRM) and mandatory verification. Each task requires proof of execution to prevent AI from gaming the system. NO vague terms like 'verify', 'check', or 'ensure'. Phase breakdown: 25+20+15+10=70 tasks.

phase1.title: Phase 1: Foundations & Data (25 tasks)
phase1.description: Atomic foundation tasks with explicit verification: API contracts, database setup, data models. Each task uses action verbs (CREATE, EXECUTE, RUN, COMPILE) and requires proof.

tasks.title: [TASK-001] CREATE OpenAPI Spec Structure & SHOW Validation Pass
tasks.description: CREATE OpenAPI 3.0 specification file with info, servers, and empty paths/components sections. EXECUTE openapi-validator and PASTE output showing spec is valid.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: OpenAPI file exists, basic structure complete, openapi-validator shows 'Spec is valid'

verification.expectedState: Validation passed, spec is valid

tasks.title: [TASK-002] DEFINE All Schema Components & SHOW Completeness
tasks.description: DEFINE ALL schema components in OpenAPI spec with complete field definitions. NO empty schemas. SHOW schema section with grep and EXECUTE validator to confirm 0 errors.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: All entities have complete schemas, all fields typed, required fields marked, no TODO/placeholder text, validator passes

verification.expectedState: All schemas defined with complete fields, validator passes, no placeholders

tasks.title: [TASK-003] DEFINE All API Paths & EXECUTE $ref Validation
tasks.description: DEFINE ALL API paths with operations, parameters, request/response schemas. EXECUTE validator to confirm all $ref references resolve to existing schemas from TASK-002.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: All paths defined, all operations complete, all $refs valid (no broken references), validator passes with 0 errors

verification.expectedState: All validators pass, all $refs resolve, no broken references

tasks.constitutionalCompliance: ✅ API-First Gate with complete API definition
